version: LOCK 83 V1 (9 Nov 2026) - Visiting the sick
builds_on: LOCK 2 prayer, LOCK 3 Idris, LOCK 6 regulars, LOCK 34 runner. Private counters go to the Journal; worship never earns trust.

a.text: Old Musa hasn't been at prayer for three days. Idris says he is ill in his room behind the inn and that nobody has been to see him.

choices.label: Visit him and sit a while

sit.text: Musa is delighted. He tells you about his boat for an hour and is asleep before you leave.

soup.text: Musa drinks the soup and holds the warm bowl a long time after it's empty.

later.text: When you finally go, a week later, Musa is back at prayer.

visited: Visited Old Musa when he was ill
